hero.title: Certified Growth Partners Supporting Entrepreneur Success
hero.description: EPEW works with professional partners who help entrepreneurs develop, prepare, launch, promote, and grow successful businesses.

ecosystem.title: Entrepreneurs Are Supported by a Professional Ecosystem
ecosystem.paragraph1: From the moment an entrepreneur is approved, EPEW connects them to a coordinated support system. Certified Growth Partners help provide the guidance, services, preparation, and visibility needed to build a real business.
ecosystem.paragraph2: After the coach introduces the entrepreneur to the appropriate professional support, the entrepreneur gains access to service requests through the EPEW Professional Service Center.

formation.title: Business Formation Partners
formation.text: Help entrepreneurs establish professional business structures correctly from the beginning.

financial.title: Financial & Compliance Partners
financial.text: Support entrepreneurs with financial readiness, compliance preparation, accounting, payroll, and tax-related organization.

development.title: Business Development Partners
development.text: Assist entrepreneurs with planning, organization, readiness, business consulting, and operational development.

branding.title: Branding & Design Partners
branding.text: Help entrepreneurs create a professional business image, including logo, business cards, flyers, brochures, banners, and promotional materials.

promotion.title: Promotion & Media Partners
promotion.text: Help entrepreneurs gain visibility through business promotion, media coverage, social media, community exposure, and launch communication.

launch.title: Launch & Event Partners
launch.text: Support grand opening planning, event setup, business launch activities, community events, and public introduction.

review.title: Coach Review
review.text: The coach identifies the entrepreneur’s needs.

introduction.title: Partner Introduction
introduction.text: EPEW introduces the right professional support.

request.title: Service Request
request.text: The entrepreneur requests the service through the platform.

delivery.title: Service Delivery
delivery.text: The partner completes the service with progress updates.

strength.title: Partners Strengthen the Ecosystem
strength.description: Certified Growth Partners help transform ideas into prepared, professional, visible, and sustainable businesses.
